Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Essa vaga é para você, que é apaixonado em fazer a diferença, superar metas e desafios!

Seu lugar é aqui!

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Realizar prospecção de clientes através de visitas presenciais definidas por rotas ou ações externas, garantindo qualidade de entrega de resultados de vendas.
  • Atuação externa porta a porta (PAP)
  • Prospectar novos clientes através de atuação externa de vendas;
  • Input de pedidos de clientes em sistema próprio;
  • Apoiar clientes da base com possíveis problemas e trazer soluções;
  • Negociação de produtos e serviços com clientes de acordo com políticas comerciais;
  • Atingir metas pré-estabelecidas por gestores.
  • Ter no mínimo 18 anos;
  • Experiência com vendas;
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência com vendas PAP;
  • Capacidade de organização, objetividade e senso de urgência;
  • Pro atividade, comprometimento e vontade de superar desafios;
  • Boa fluência verbal para contato com clientes;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Residir nas regiões:

  • Rio de Janeiro - Angra dos Reis, Araruama, Armação dos Búzios, Barra Mansa, Barra de Piraí, Iguaba Grande, Itaperuna, Mangaratiba,Niterói, Paraty, Petrópolis, Resende, Rio Bonito, Rio das Ostras, Rio de Janeiro, São Pedro da Aldeia, Teresópolis, Três Rios, Rio Bonito, Valença e Volta Redonda

Horário de Trabalho

segunda a sexta das 09h00 às 18h00 e sábado das 09h00 às 13h00

Jornada de Trabalho

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Auxílio funeral;
  • Auxílio creche / Criança especial;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Descontos em Academias / Práticas Esportivas;
  • Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos.
  • Step 3: Validação com o Requisitante 3 Validação com o Requisitante

Muito prazer, somos a Atento!

Aqui no Grupo Atento – formado também pela empresa Interfile – acreditamos que a melhor experiência do cliente começa com o respeito e cuidado com as pessoas . E isso vale para todo mundo que faz parte da nossa companhia! Se você está em busca da sua primeira oportunidade , ou já tem uma bagagem profissional incrível , o nosso convite é o mesmo: vem crescer com a gente!

A Atento é uma das cinco maiores empresas do mundo em serviços de relacionamento com o cliente e terceirização de processos (CRM/BPO) – e a líder absoluta na América Latina ! Estamos em 17 países , com mais de 95 centros de relacionamento e 110 mil postos de trabalho . Atendemos mais de 400 clientes , muitas delas gigantes globais nas áreas de tecnologia, telecom, finanças, saúde, varejo e muito mais.

Juntar tecnologia + humanização para criar conexões reais e experiências inesquecíveis entre marcas e consumidores. A cada interação, queremos fazer a diferença – enriquecendo vidas e gerando valor para os negócios dos nossos clientes.

Nossa cultura tem nome: One Atento

"One Atento" é a forma que temos de fazer as coisas por aqui – com propósito, união e um olhar sempre voltado para o futuro. São seis valores que nos guiam todos os dias:parceiros estratégicos ,cuidamos das nossas pessoas ,em equipe vencemos ,ágil e simples ,mente aberta eentrega de resultados .

O que faz um vendedor PaP?

O vendedor PaP também conhecido como vendedor externo, faz a prospecção de clientes através de visitas presenciais definidas por rotas ou ações externas, garantindo qualidade de entrega de resultados de vendas.

O que faz um supervisor Pap?

Seu papel é liderar a equipe na busca dos melhores resultados, garantindo que a equipe siga os direcionamentos avaliando as entregas e oportunidades propostas em cima dos desafios regionais e plano comercial!

Temos oportunidades em todos os estados do Brasil.

Quais os requisitos mínimos para concorrer à vaga?

Para vendedor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino fundamental completo e experiência com vendas (de qualquer modalidade).

Para supervisor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino médio completo, experiência com vendas e liderança, CNH e veículo próprio.

Como é o processo seletivo?

Você fará seu cadastro, participará de uma entrevista com o RH e depois com o requisitante.

Processo simples e rápido! #VemserAtento!

Quais os benefícios?

Acesse a vaga da sua região e verifique as informações de salário, comissão e benefícios!#TransparêncianoProcesso!

Conheça também os nossos outros Portais de Carreiras:

Interfile – com vagas voltadas para soluções de backoffice e gestão de processos;

Portal PcD – com vagas exclusivas para pessoas com deficiência.

Esclarecemos que nenhum valor é cobrado para que você participe dos nossos processos seletivos. Caso seja solicitado a você qualquer pagamento em troca de apostilas, treinamentos ou até mesmo inscrição nas nossas vagas, fique alerta e faça um Boletim de Ocorrência na delegacia mais próxima. Nenhuma companhia, seja ela nossa parceira ou não, possui permissão para exigir pagamentos em nome da Atento. Oferecemos também o canal para denúncias em caso de recebimento de mensagens inadequadas ou impróprias.

title: Product Designer (Relocation to Vietnam)
description:
Overview

Product Designer (Relocation to Vietnam) – Elfie. Join to apply for the Product Designer role at Elfie. Elfie provides relocation support to Vietnam for expats.

Shape the Future of Global Health, from Vietnam. If you're looking for a mission with global reach, real impact, and a team that scales fast and learns even faster, you’ve just found your next move.

About Elfie

Elfie is the first completely free, gamified mobile app that rewards users for managing their health. Our goal is to become the world’s largest self-reported medical record platform across all therapeutic areas. We operate in 10+ countries today, with plans to expand into 15 by the end of 2025. Try Elfie for yourself by downloading it on the App Store or Google Play.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Elfie, you’ll be at the forefront of shaping how our vision translates into meaningful user and business outcomes. You’ll own end-to-end product experiences, from identifying user needs to defining workflows and shaping solutions that drive real impact in healthcare. You will collaborate closely with founders, engineers, and data teams to ship features that are intuitive, scalable, and strategically aligned. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on solving complex problems with clarity, care, and craft.

What You’ll Get

  • Permanent Global Contract – With a competitive salary
  • Private Healthcare – From day one
  • Top-Tier Tech Setup – Brand new MacBook + full onboarding kit
  • Career Growth Framework – Clear, personalised, and fast-moving
  • 14 Days PTO + Public Holidays – Real time off
  • Hybrid Working – 3 days in the office per week
  • Refreshments – Free Lunch and Dinner every day for you to enjoy

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with founders and the product team to understand business goals, product vision, and service objectives.
  • Translate ideas into clear, actionable design documentation that supports both product specification and engineering implementation.
  • Research, design, and shape end-to-end product experiences for users across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Map out user journeys, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs to explore and communicate design solutions throughout the iterative process.
  • Produce prototypes, visual assets, and interface components to support testing and development.
  • Continuously refine and enhance the product experience based on user insights and feedback.

What You’ll Need

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a UI/UX or product design role, with a strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end mobile app design.
  • Proficient in Figma (required), with additional experience in tools like Adobe Suite considered a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects across fast-paced environments with strong planning, time management, and stakeholder alignment skills.
  • Fluent in English, with clear communication and documentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience in product development is a bonus, especially in software or tech-focused environments.
  • Proactive, self-motivated mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to dive into details to meet goals.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and adapting designs in an iterative, fast-changing product cycle.
  • Solid foundation in visual design, including drawing, color theory, and layout.
  • Portfolio highlights strong visual craft and ability to solve complex interaction problems.
  • Awareness of current trends in mobile UX/UI and game-inspired interfaces. Bonus points for proficiency in Lottie, Rive, or other motion tools.

Why Join Elfie

We’re a global start-up that is mission-led and fiercely product-driven. We’re building something that improves lives with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

What Now?

Apply today for immediate consideration. If you know someone who would be a good fit, we offer a referral reward if your recommendation is hired. Contact Talent Acquisition for more information.

title: Account Manager
description:
Direct message the job poster from Upstream

Human Resources Associate @ Upstream | Full Life Cycle Recruiting | MSc in Strategic HRM

Who we are

We are a leader in mobile technology, providing innovative solutions to 1.2 billion consumers. In an ever-increasing digital world we help businesses grow their digital reach & toolkits to optimize user experience, increase engagement, attract new customers and boost their revenues.

Think of performance marketing but on steroids as our top-notch marketeers and engineers build digital journeys through an omnichannel marketing approach like no other. Currently we work with the biggest names in Telco, Insurance, Education, FMCGs and Retail in over 45 countries in Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and South-East Asia.

The role:

This role is ideal for a high-potential candidate who wishes to be rewarded for strong performance while gaining valuable international business experience on large-scale mobile marketing projects.

The position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Please submit your CV in English.

Main Responsibilities

  • Ownership of the client relationship: act as the key point of contact between the client and Upstream, managing expectations, securing satisfaction, and maintaining strong day-to-day communication.
  • Commercial ownership of the account: contribute to account planning and target achievement; lead contract negotiations and closing; monitor performance; maintain account P&L; support reconciliations, invoicing, and payments.
  • Coordinate operational resources and ensure operational delivery, including regulatory requirements, supplier contracts, and recruitment channels; be accountable for client deliverables and local market inputs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure project plans are executed on time and with high quality.
  • Monitor performance: KPIs, sales funnel, channels, deliverables activities.
  • Identify opportunities for upselling within own projects and expanding Upstream's services to other departments
  • Identify local partners and product opportunities.
  • Constantly monitor the competitive landscape and detect potential risks

Requirements

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

The ideal candidate will be ambitious, self-driven, and flexible, with the following qualifications:

  • BSc/MSc, preferably in Business Administration, Engineering, or Marketing.
  • 5-8 years of work experience in consulting, marketing, telecoms, or technology.
  • Excellent command of the English language (spoken and written).
  • Excellent client-facing and negotiation skills.
  • Solid quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to perform under pressure and deliver results in a demanding, fast-paced environment that requires fresh thinking and innovation.
  • Solid understanding of the mobile, web, and digital advertising industry.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable in a field that combines technology, marketing, and consumer behavior.
  • International perspective and cultural awareness.
  • Experience with mobile operators and its core business will be considered a plus.

Other Key Considerations

  • Experience in budget management and cost control.
  • Experience in business development, account management, or B2B client support.
  • Marketing mindset and creative capability.
  • Availability for travel.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits, directly dependent on the candidate's qualifications and skills. The real excitement comes from working closely with a dynamic, smart, agile and highly motivated team in a competitive and fast paced environment.

description:
Descrição

A pessoa atuará como Analista Comercial III, na qual terá Influência em decisões comerciais alinhadas à cultura da empresa. Responsável por propostas comerciais complexas, negociação com clientes estratégicos e construção de soluções junto a áreas técnicas e administrativas. Análise de dados, mercado e performance contratual para geração de insights e apoio à diretoria. Criação de dashboards, KPIs e apresentações executivas para embasar decisões estratégicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaborar propostas comerciais, levando em consideração variáveis de risco, margem de lucro e condições específicas de cada operação;
  • Manter a interface entre áreas técnicas, financeira, jurídica, operações, suprimentos e demais áreas envolvidas para consolidar propostas;
  • Apoiar na negociação de termos comerciais com clientes estratégicos;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de estratégias de precificação e diferenciação técnica;
  • Desenvolver e manter relatórios analíticos e dashboards para monitoramento de desempenho, oferecendo insights para a equipe e para a diretoria;
  • Elaborar apresentações comerciais que reflitam as estratégias e os resultados alcançados, alinhando expectativas entre a empresa e os clientes;
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado, incluindo análises comerciais, estratégias dos concorrentes e comportamento do cliente, para identificar oportunidades de crescimento e otimização;
  • Identificar tendências e padrões sazonais, analisando dados históricos para prever demandas e ajustar estratégias comerciais;
  • Realizar análise contínua de dados comerciais, avaliando o desempenho de contratos, indicadores operacionais e estratégias da área, a fim de propor melhorias e apoiar a tomada de decisões;
  • Calcular e monitorar KPIs (indicadores-chave de performance), fornecendo relatórios periódicos sobre a saúde financeira e operacional da área comercial.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência na área ou função similar.

Sobre a vaga: O Projetista de Tubulação será responsável pela modelagem, detalhamento e desenvolvimento de projetos de sistemas de tubulação aplicados a embarcações, plataformas e estruturas offshore. Esse profissional terá papel essencial na elaboração de desenhos técnicos, isométricos e listas de materiais, assegurando que todas as soluções estejam alinhadas com os requisitos técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios da indústria naval e offshore.

Formação e experiência

  • Curso Técnico completo em Projetos Mecânicos, Tubulação, Mecânica, Engenharia Naval ou áreas afins.
  • Desejável formação complementar em Engenharia ou cursos de especialização em tubulação industrial/naval.
  • Registro no CREA (para técnicos ou tecnólogos).
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando como projetista de tubulação em ambientes navais, offshore ou óleo gás.
  • Vivência com projetos de sistemas complexos de tubulação a bordo de FPSOs, embarcações de apoio marítimo, sondas, plataformas fixas ou módulos industriais.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e revisar modelos 3D de tubulação usando ferramentas específicas (AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks).
  • Elaborar isométricos, desenhos ortogonais, layouts e listas de materiais (BOM/MTO).
  • Realizar roteamento de linhas considerando espaço, interferências, suporte, manutenção e acessibilidade.
  • Participar de revisões de projeto (model review) com equipes multidisciplinares, propondo soluções de engenharia.
  • Garantir que os desenhos estejam em conformidade com os PIDs, normas de classe e diretrizes do projeto.
  • Verificar interferências e colisões (clash detection) junto às disciplinas de estrutura, elétrica e instrumentação.
  • Preparar documentação técnica de apoio à fabricação e montagem.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e coordenadores de projeto na definição de especificações e padrões técnicos.
  • Apoiar na compatibilização de disciplinas e interface com fornecedores e estaleiros quando necessário.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)

  • Domínio em ferramentas de modelagem e detalhamento de tubulação:
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks, SmartPlant ou equivalentes.
  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas de processo (PID), fluxogramas, plantas e cortes.
  • Conhecimento em materiais e classes de tubulação (carbono, inox, duplex, cobre-níquel etc.)
  • Componentes de sistemas de tubulação: válvulas, flanges, suportes, juntas de expansão, etc.
  • Normas e códigos aplicáveis: ASME B31.3 / B31.1, API, NORSOK, ISO, NR-13, entre outros.
  • Noções de cálculo de suportação e esforço, embora não seja um cargo de engenharia.
  • Experiência com sistemas típicos de embarcações e offshore, como:
  • Sistemas de lastro, incêndio, ar-condicionado, combustível, ar comprimido, água potável e esgoto.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de projeto naval, requisitos de classe (DNV, ABS, BV).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de normas, especificações e comunicação com equipes globais.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Atenção aos detalhes: compromisso com qualidade, precisão e conformidade técnica.
  • Organização: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos entregáveis com eficiência.
  • Comunicação clara: para dialogar com equipes internas, engenheiros, fornecedores e estaleiros.
  • Trabalho em equipe: colaboração ativa com diferentes disciplinas.
  • Proatividade: iniciativa para propor melhorias técnicas e identificar possíveis inconsistências de projeto.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: agilidade para lidar com alterações de escopo e prazos apertados.
  • Comprometimento com prazos e excelência técnica.

Se você tem experiência sólida em projetos de tubulação naval e quer atuar em uma empresa global com foco em engenharia de ponta, segurança e inovação, essa vaga é para você.

Overview

Job Description - Coordenador BIM (RIO00DP)

Primary Location: BRA-RDJ-Rio de Janeiro

Construindo sobre nosso passado. Prontos para o futuro

A Worley é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais composta por especialistas em energia, produtos químicos e recursos. Estabelecemos parcerias com clientes para entregar projetos e criar valor ao longo da vida de seus ativos. Estamos a unir dois mundos, avançando em direção a fontes de energia mais sustentáveis, ao mesmo tempo que ajudamos a fornecer a energia, os produtos químicos e os recursos necessários agora.

Procuramos um Coordenador(a) BIM para liderar a implementação, gestão e padronização de processos BIM em projetos de engenharia Onshore, assegurando conformidade com normas e integração com sistemas corporativos e dos clientes. O profissional será responsável por coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, gerir o fluxo de informações do projeto e garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas de Building Information Modeling para otimizar a qualidade e a eficiência na entrega dos empreendimentos.

Responsibilities

  • Planejar, coordenar e supervisionar a execução da estratégia BIM em todas as fases do projeto.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas, padrões corporativos e diretrizes como ISO 19650 .
  • Definir e implementar o BEP (BIM Execution Plan) e outros documentos de gestão BIM.
  • Coordenar a integração entre modelos BIM de diferentes disciplinas (arquitetura, estrutura, instalações, processos industriais, etc.).
  • Validar modelos digitais, assegurando consistência, integridade e qualidade das informações.
  • Promover integração entre plataformas BIM e sistemas corporativos (COMOS, AVEVA, Revit, Navisworks, entre outros).
  • Gerenciar revisões e controle de versões dos modelos digitais.
  • Treinar e dar suporte às equipes de projeto quanto às metodologias, ferramentas e fluxos BIM.
  • Apoiar clientes e stakeholders na interpretação e uso de informações geradas em ambiente BIM.
  • Participar ativamente na análise e proposição de melhorias nos processos digitais da companhia.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação de projetos BIM em indústrias de grande porte (óleo & gás, energia, mineração, infraestrutura).
  • Experiência com gestão de modelos multidisciplinares e detecção de interferências (Clash Detection).
  • Conhecimento de normas e padrões BIM nacionais e internacionais (incluindo ISO 19650).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e comunicação com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com integração BIM em plataformas de gestão documental (Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint).
  • Conhecimento em programação visual (Dynamo, Grasshopper) e/ou linguagens de script aplicadas ao BIM.
  • Certificações em BIM Management.
  • Espanhol técnico.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Liderança e habilidade de gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Organização, proatividade e foco em resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação.
  • Visão estratégica para evolução dos processos.

Observação : caso necessite de algum ajuste de acessibilidade, por favor não deixe de mencionar na sua candidatura.

Avançando juntos

Estamos empenhados em construir um local de trabalho diversificado, inclusivo e respeitoso, onde todos sintam que pertencem, possam falar e sejam ouvidos. Estamos construindo um local de trabalho diversificado, inclusivo e respeitoso. Criar um espaço onde todos sintam que pertencem, possam ser eles mesmos e sejam ouvidos. E não estamos apenas falando sobre isso; estamos fazendo isso.

Somos referência nacional no fornecimento de terceirização de Emergency Response para infraestruturas críticas, atuando em três pilares essenciais: Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho, Urgência e Emergência, Prevenção e combate a incêndios.

Você se identifica com a nossa empresa? Então essa é a sua chance!

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e ser um Med Member.

Responsibilities

  • Realizar atendimento psicológico de forma individual ou em grupo
  • Verificar a elegibilidade do empregado a algum programa específico de saúde e/ou da necessidade de encaminhamento para especialista externo
  • Propor, planejar e gerir interfaces com equipe multidisciplinar de saúde e demais áreas da PETROBRAS, quando pertinente
  • Assessorar às lideranças, gerências, recursos humanos, SMS, e demais integrantes do Serviço de Saúde quanto aos riscos psicossociais

  • Propor, planejar e gerir abordagem específica, com orientações e monitoramentos regulares, conforme protocolos a serem disponibilizados pela PETROBRAS para empregados e público-alvo dos programas
  • Prestar orientações, e realizar atendimento em programas de saúde que possam envolver dependência química, qualidade de vida, saúde mental, relacionamento interpessoal e profissional, dentre outros, conforme normas e orientações da PETROBRAS
  • Prestar orientações, e realizar acolhimento de saude em situações de violência no trabalho, de forma individualizada e coletiva
  • Elaborar material, proferir palestras e atuar em práticas educativas sobre temas relacionados à saúde, tendo como público-alvo, lideranças, força de trabalho, profissionais de saúde/Recursos Humanos
  • Promover a saúde mental no ambiente de trabalho através de ações colaborativas, especializadas e multidisciplinares para toda força de trabalho
  • Realizar avaliação dos fatores psicossociais relacionados ao trabalho e o impacto das mudanças organizacionais e tecnológicas sobre a saúde mental dos empregados

title: Executive Operations Director
description:
Executive Operations Director

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: Sarai Bareman

Description

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027").

THE POSITION

The Executive Operations Director, under the guidance of the Executive Tournament Director and in close collaboration with the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup is responsible for the successful operational delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and all related events in accordance with the comprehensive project plan. This includes ensuring the appropriate hosting conditions are provided in collaboration with the host cities, stadium and venue owners, local authorities and third-party entities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leadership & Team Management:
    • Lead and manage the operations team, working closely with all key stakeholders (FIFA Zurich, state and federal government where necessary, host cities, commercial partners, etc.).
    • Ensure effective collaboration between all departments and individuals involved in the tournament's operations.
    • Provide strategic guidance and decision-making during the tournament planning and execution phases.
    • Specifically, the Executive Operations Director shall be responsible for the key operational departments within FIFA27 Brazil, including: Venue Operations, Competitions & Team Services, Safety, security, accreditation & access control, Technology, Events & Entertainment, Medical, Technical Services / Infrastructure, Broadcast and media, Event Services (such as transportation, logistics, travel and accommodation).
  • Operational Planning & Execution:
    • Oversee the operational execution of the FIFA Women’s World Cup, covering all tournament venues, from logistics and planning through to match-day operations.
    • Implement and oversee operational plans, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s goals, budgets, and timelines.
    • Coordinate various functional areas to ensure seamless operations at all venues.
    • Manage the operational budget, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently across all functional areas.
    • Report on financial performance and provide operational cost optimization strategies.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Extensive Experience in Major Sports Events:
    • At least 8-10 years of experience in managing operations for large-scale sports events (e.g. World Cup, Olympic Games, continental championships, etc.).
    • Proven track record of managing cross-functional teams for international sporting events, with an emphasis on logistics, venue management, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Leadership & Management:
    • Strong experience in leading large teams, with the ability to manage diverse and high-performing teams.
    • Previous experience in a senior management role with decision-making authority.
    • Ability to work in high-pressure environments and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Operational Expertise:
    • In-depth knowledge of operational best practices in international sports events, including logistics, security, transportation, and venue operations.
    • Experience managing logistics for major international sporting events, including team operations, transport, logistics, goods delivery.
  • Knowledge of Sports Governance and Regulations:
    • Strong understanding of FIFA regulations, tournament operations, and the international sports governance landscape.
    • Knowledge of the compliance and safety standards required for international events.
  • Crisis Management & Problem Solving:
    • Strong crisis management skills with a proven ability to handle unforeseen challenges during large-scale events.
    • Ability to think quickly and implement solutions under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Management:
    • Proven ability to manage substantial operational budgets and resources.
    • Experience in cost control, optimizing event operations within budget constraints.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
    • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
    • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including sponsors, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
    • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
    • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian) with proficiency in additional languages (e.g., Spanish, French) preferred.

description:
EY Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em FSO, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

#TAXFSO

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo.

hybrid

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Gerente de Tributos você será parte da área de Tax com foco na indústria financeira, atuando em consultoria tributária, auxiliando as empresas em projetos de compliance e consultoria em impostos diretos (CSLL e IRPJ) para bancos e seguradoras, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação da apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social seguindo as normas e legislações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder as consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo/a ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – lucro real e lucro presumido) e na preparação e revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Join to apply for the Access Center Nurse Coordinator role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Position Summary

Under the direction of the Sr. Director of Clinical Development, Department Chair, or assigned Director, the Nurse Coordinator is a vital clinical leader responsible for supporting high-quality patient care through a combination of direct clinical services (Resource Time ) and care coordination, communication, and planning activities (Coordination Time ). This role ensures safe, efficient, and patient-centered care while improving communication between patients, clinical staff, and providers. The Nurse Coordinator can be assigned to two of the following departments; Surgery, Medicine, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Ophthalmology, Neurology, Psychiatry, Family Medicine, Dermatology, Women’s Health, FPP Administration or the Access Center.

Key Responsibilities

Resource Time – Clinical Care & Education

Time allocated for direct patient-facing care and in-clinic clinical responsibilities, including:

  • Attend and make recommendations for departmental huddles and delegation of clinical duties
  • Perform clinical skills, medication administration, and other direct care duties
  • Support daily clinic operations, triage, and patient flow
  • Educate patients and families on health conditions, medications, and follow-up instructions
  • Participate in and deliver in-service training and continuing education to staff
  • Ensure accurate documentation of all clinical activities in the EHR
  • Monitor for quality concerns during clinical care and escalate as needed
  • Support referral management, by triaging referrals against Schedule Advisor protocols
  • Support authorization team, by responding to peer-to-peer requests
  • Provide pre-surgery and pre-procedure patient education
  • Route patients to follow up appointments post discharge
  • Work with the Access Center Nursing team to implement red/yellow/green triage matrix

Coordination Time – Planning, Collaboration & Administrative Support

Time dedicated to activities that support quality and continuity of care, including:

  • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings and provider collaboration sessions with Providers
  • Review labs, imaging, and patient messages/tasks to support timely follow-up
  • Coordinate patient care across departments during afternoon staffing huddle
  • Support tracking and follow-up of patients with chronic conditions, missed appointments, or abnormal results
  • Engage in quality improvement activities like QSI rounds, chart reviews, and safety checks
  • Maintain accurate records for compliance with clinical guidelines and regulatory requirements
  • Assist with patient outreach to support adherence to treatment plans or follow-up appointments
  • Manage prescription refills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Registered RN – Required
  • DC License – Required or within 90 days if active current state license
  • BSN, MSN or MHSA, MPH or equivalent – Preferred
  • Certified in clinical specialty – Preferred
  • 2+ years experience in an academic health system - Preferred
  • 3+ years ambulatory nursing experience or 2 years inpatient experience on a med/surg unit - Required

Core Competencies

  • Patient-centered care and cultural sensitivity
  • Clinical judgment and escalation awareness
  • Effective communication with multidisciplinary teams
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting
  • Attention to detail and commitment to clinical excellence

Work Environment

  • Ambulatory clinical setting with a balance of patient-facing and administrative duties
  • May require sitting, standing, and moving between care areas throughout the day
  • Requires indirect supervision of non-licensed staff and/or medical assistants

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally. We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally. We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people. We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It is a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amounts that are not billed timely or become aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Fluent English.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more. Our website: Airswift is

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

title: Product Designer Sênior
description:
Overview

Afya Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação! Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica, para trabalhar de forma híbrida na cidade de Rio de Janeiro/São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. Ao assumir o cargo de Product Designer Sênior na Afya, seu objetivo principal será garantir a experiência do usuário nos produtos, visando relacionar tanto os aspectos de usabilidade nas entregas, quanto aspectos de estratégia visando construir uma solução pautada sempre em feedbacks de usuários e em dados relevantes. Você atuará na área de Product Designer dentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto, tecnologia e dados. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e conduzir descobertas a fim de identificar e mapear oportunidades e dores relevantes dos nossos usuários e clientes, por meio de pesquisas e entrevistas com usuários;
  • Propor e participar da experimentação de hipóteses e conceitos, validando-os por meio de pesquisa com usuários, testes A/B, multivariáveis, split tests ou outros métodos de validação, a fim de ajudar na estratégia do produto;
  • Colaborar na definição de indicadores de sucesso e acompanhá-los por meio de follow ups recorrentes, para apoiar as decisões e direcionamentos do negócio;
  • Usar dados no desenvolvimento do projeto para formular hipóteses e sustentar decisões de Design;
  • Facilitar workshops e atividades de concepção junto ao time para guiar o desenvolvimento do produto, a fim de ter uma troca multidiscliplinar;
  • Executar e acompanhar processos de pesquisa com usuários, utilizando seus insights na construção e otimização do produto;
  • Construir e iterar experiências que estejam conectadas com objetivos de negócio e necessidades dos nossos usuários para alavancar a estratégia do produto;
  • Definir novos fluxos; criar interfaces usando nosso design system; criar protótipos de baixa, média e alta fidelidade quando preciso; realizando o handoff e acompanhamento da sua implementação

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Portfólio que mostre impacto real no negócio e na experiência do usuário, incluindo cases de estratégia, simplificação de jornadas e evolução de produto.
  • Experiência sólida em UI Design, com cases que envolvam design systems, mockups, protótipos e microinterações.
  • Vivência em manutenção e escala de design systems, com habilidade para propor, evoluir e escalar componentes.
  • Domínio de princípios e heurísticas de design, boas práticas de UX/UI e proficiência no Figma.
  • Experiência em product discovery e no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais em ambientes web e mobile.
  • Excelente comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e facilitar decisões de produto a partir de argumentos claros e bem estruturados.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e KPIs, sabendo como usá-los para orientar decisões de design.
  • Mentalidade curiosa para explorar e experimentar ferramentas e tecnologias de IA.
  • Interesse em se manter atualizado(a) sobre tendências em IA e aplicá-las nos desafios de design.

Informações adicionais

GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time. Confira os principais abaixo:

Para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;

  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Psicologia Viva (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista);
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D\'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:

title: Product Delivery Planner
description:
Overview

Do you enjoy being part of team that provides high-quality project delivery for our customers?

Are you passionate about meticulous planning and attention to detail?

Join a team that delivers essential projects

We devise smarter systems to control and monitor oil and gas extraction. Innovating in the energy industry, our subsea and surface pressure capabilities are industry leading. Our team is responsible for the successful development, deployment, and delivery of our cutting-edge, world class control systems.

Responsibilities

As Product Delivery Planner you will be in-charge of planning a large subsea project. The planner will be accountable for the schedule quality and project on-time delivery. The position reports to the Project Delivery Planning Manager.

As a Product Delivery Planner, you will be responsible for:

  • Scheduling Management: The planner is in-charge of the overall project schedule management, ensuring its quality (logic, clarity) and accuracy (update of dates, reflection of the scope of supply).
  • Coordinating: The planner will be collaborating with the other planners (product line planner & engineering planners) allocated to the project and with the execution functions (engineering, procurement, and manufacturing) to ensure the overall quality and accuracy of the schedule.
  • Supporting Project management: The planner is the right-hand of the project manager and, as such, will provide visibility on: i) Looking ahead of tasks to be performed in the 3 – 6 weeks; ii) Risks in schedules and mitigation actions; iii) Opportunities in the schedule.
  • Providing relevant reports to project management to ensure the project manager has all the tools to make the right decisions and drive on-time and on-budget project execution.
  • Interacting with the customer to provide schedule updates and explain the current situation, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Adhering to the approved processes and proactively drive the implementation of new initiatives that will lead to fully integrated planning.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor / Master’s degree or equivalent (Engineering / Math/ Science degree is ).
  • Have expressive experience working within planning, ideally in the oil and gas/subsea industry or a related large-scale mechanical manufacturing or controls equipment environment.
  • Be an expert in the use of the Primavera P6 planning tool.
  • Have additional knowledge of Oracle MRP is considered a plus.
  • Have ability to understand the status of a project and link the schedule to the reality of the execution.
  • Have ability to quickly understand the risks and opportunities in the schedule and identify and drive appropriate actions.
  • Have strong expertise in planning a large project and using the Primavera P6 planning tool.
  • Have high energy and motivation to deliver against and beyond expectations, making a difference in the position.
  • Have strong leadership and excellent interpersonal skills are required to collaborate with a team of planners and interact with a large panel of individuals who will contribute to the project's performance.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

title: Manager, Overlay Cluster
description:
Manager, Overlay Cluster

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Implement change management processes and maintain budget control for venues under your responsibility. Organize, coordinate, and oversee the flow of technical information (e.g., drawings, requirements, updates) across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain clear communication with stadium authorities to ensure alignment on timelines, by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Work closely with overlay delivery partners from planning through construction and removal, monitoring the execution of the project scope to ensure all requirements are met and that spaces are handed over on time and to the expected quality throughout all project phases, including reinstatement.
  • Provide regular updates on overlay progress at assigned venues, track project milestones and deliverables, and support timely resolution of issues or delays.
  • Support operational design development by transforming raw data into accurate base CAD drawings, integrating operational, overlay, and legacy content, and ensuring all updates adhere to FIFA standards and templates. Delivering complete and timely drawing sets aligned with project schedules and inspection requirements.
  • Align and establish a clear and consistent code/naming convention for commodities to be integrated into the design, enabling effective status tracking and change management control.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization.

title: Senior Manager, Service Delivery
description:
Senior Manager, Service Delivery

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Establish and implement a fit for purpose integrated support model (including FIFA, technology partners, service providers, government entities etc.) across all phases of the project.
  • Management / implementation of IT Service management processes and procedures including the management of the ITSM tool.
  • Establish service level agreements (SLAs) in accordance with the FIFA Technology Handbook across all technology services.
  • Be the lead manager for Service Delivery area within the FWWC27 Technology Project team
  • Recruitment of direct reports in the next phase of hiring & contracting, who will in turn be responsible to deliver their key area of scope.
  • Lead on the definition of the Asset tracking and management of deployed equipment in all sites.
  • Ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed to scope, within budget and on schedule.
  • Continuously review and make recommendations to improve technology across the tournament.
  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organizational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Service Delivery Management.
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical skills and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team Player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • ITIL foundations
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Especialista de Arquitetura – RIOgaleão – Aeroporto Internacional Tom Jobim

Um aeroporto com a alma carioca! O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade. Aqui somos contagiados pelo Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser, onde nossos Integrantes atuam com garra e determinação para alcançar resultados, são incentivados a buscar o autodesenvolvimento , sendo agentes do próprio destino profissional, trabalham em equipe com colaboração e empatia e são norteados por um espírito de dono , cuidando e perseguindo sempre os melhores resultados. Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Especialista de Arquitetura .

Neste desafio você utilizará a disciplina técnica de arquitetura e repertório para antecipar cenários, avaliar riscos e impactos, e assegurar que todos os projetos estejam alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos do aeroporto, garantindo eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória e otimização de recursos em um ambiente de alta complexidade e dinamismo, se mantendo atualizado às tendências e tecnologias existentes no mercado da arquitetura e aviação.

Esse desafio requer que você desempenhe as seguintes atividades :

  • Realizar interface com stakeholders para definir e elaborar o programa de necessidades de cada escopo, garantindo alinhamento desde o início do projeto;
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos com uma visão técnica e operacional, alinhando as necessidades do aeroporto às soluções propostas;
  • Desenvolver escopos detalhados, com foco em arquitetura e áreas relacionadas, apresentando clareza e domínio das necessidades a serem contratadas;
  • Analyzar propostas técnicas e realizar aprovações das mesmas em acordo com os escopos elaborados;
  • Acompanhar e controlar contratos de projetos executivos de arquitetura e disciplinas complementares, garantindo compatibilização e aderência ao programa de necessidade e objetivo do projeto;
  • Criar cronogramas de projeto e execução, considerando prazos internos, janelas operacionais e sazonalidade, de modo a minimizar impactos na experiência dos passageiros;
  • Qualificar e identificar novos fornecedores, adotando uma postura crítica para assegurar a aplicabilidade técnica de cada parceiro em relação ao escopo;
  • Garantir aderência e assertividade entre o planejado e o que é efetivamente executado, promovendo controle de qualidade;
  • Participar de projetos complexos que demandam alinhamento constante, comunicação eficaz de possíveis desvios e uma visão estratégica na contratação;
  • Fornecer direcionamento técnico ao projeto do início ao fim, atendendo aos prazos, às premissas estabelecidas, realizando vistorias de qualidade e avaliando fornecedores;
  • Identificar e implementar oportunidades de otimização de custos e análise de valor em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do Capex, sem comprometer a segurança e a qualidade;
  • Realizar handovers claros, organizados e formalizados para as equipes envolvidas, garantindo uma transição eficiente de informações;
  • Avaliar, identificar e mitigar riscos financeiros, operacionais, regulatórios e de segurança relacionados aos projetos de Capex;
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas, tecnologias e inovações no setor de arquitetura e aviação;
  • Conduzir avaliações pós-implementação, identificando lições aprendidas e promovendo melhorias contínuas nos processos de gestão de Capex.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias:

  • Formação em Arquitetura, com expressiva experiência de mercado;
  • Inglês Avançado: Essencial para interagir com fornecedores internacionais, acompanhar tendências globais e acessar literatura técnica;
  • Conhecimento da Metodologia Ágil;
  • Utilização de Ferramenta de Organização;

Você sai na frente se:

  • Pós-graduação e/ou cursos de especialização;
  • Conhecimento regulatório: familiaridade com as regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor aeroportuário (ANAC, Infraero, etc.) e normas de acessibilidade, segurança e qualidade;
  • Experiência anterior em aeroportos, shoppings, hospitais e/ou áreas de atendimento ao público com operação pulsante;
  • Experiência anterior com wayfinding e comunicação visual.

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição – Cuide da sua alimentação com R$1.315,78 mensais para escolher suas refeições preferidas e se alimentar bem todos os dias.
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco – Tenha acesso a uma rede de saúde de qualidade com o Plano de Saúde Bradesco, garantindo seu bem-estar e cuidado com a saúde.
  • Seguro de Vida Prudential – Sinta-se seguro e protegido com o Seguro de Vida Prudential, pensado para você e seus entes queridos.
  • Assistência Odontológica SulAmérica – Sorria sem preocupações com a nossa assistência odontológica da SulAmérica, que cuida da sua saúde bucal.
  • Vale Transporte – Deslocamento garantido! Aproveite o vale transporte ou vale mobilidade sem nenhum custo.
  • Gympass – Cuide do seu corpo e da sua mente com planos flexíveis e acessíveis através do Gympass, para se exercitar onde e quando quiser.
  • Parcerias com Instituições de Ensino e Lazer – Desfrute de descontos exclusivos em cursos e atividades de lazer com nossas parcerias.

title: Senior Enterprise Architect - Tietoevry Care (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

At Tietoevry Care you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About us

Tietoevry Care is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About the role

We are looking for a strategic and visionary Enterprise Architect who can define, lead, and align our technology strategy across the entire healthcare platform ecosystem. In this role, you will

  • Set the architectural direction for our platform products
  • Oversee alignment across different products
  • Ensure long-term scalability, interoperability, and maintainability
  • Support international expansion into the wider European healthcare market

You will engage directly with

  • Customers to explore new clinical and operational workflows, and digital transformation needs
  • Partners to co-develop, integrate, and ensure compatibility within a modular platform ecosystem
  • Product Management and Product Owners to align architectural vision with product strategies and roadmaps

As an Enterprise Architect, you will

  • Define and evolve the enterprise-wide architecture for our healthcare platform products
  • Align architecture across product teams, domains, and business stakeholders
  • Drive adherence to healthcare standards such as openEHR, FHIR, and HL7
  • Lead strategic architectural initiatives such as modularization, capability-based planning, and platform evolution
  • Govern architecture principles and ensure compliance across all layers (business, application, data, and infrastructure)
  • Act as a key advisor to business and product leadership regarding technology roadmaps and transformation programs
  • Guide solution and software architects and foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
  • Contribute to technology partner strategies, vendor evaluations, and interoperability initiatives

We are looking for someone with:

  • Broad experience in enterprise architecture across complex product ecosystems
  • Deep understanding of architecture principles / frameworks
  • Proven ability to align business and technology strategies
  • Familiarity with open digital health platforms and healthcare-specific standards (openEHR, FHIR)
  • Experience designing scalable and modular architecture in cloud-native and containerized environments
  • Leadership experience in driving change and enterprise-wide architecture governance
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including international and partner collaboration

As a person you are:

  • Strategic in your thinking and system-minded
  • Collaborative and able to work across different teams, organizations and cultures
  • Committed to excellence and long-term impact
  • Curious, open-minded, and adaptable

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tietoevry has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Kari-Antti Kuosa ( )

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tietoevry declines calls from recruitment companies.

About Tietoevry

Tietoevry creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, wework with our customers to develop digitalfutureswhere businesses, societies, and humanitythrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public-sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tietoevry’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

We are Hybrid

Additional Information

At Tietoevry, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Senior Enterprise Architect - Tietoevry Care (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

At Tietoevry Care you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About us

Tietoevry Care is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About the role

We are looking for a strategic and visionary Enterprise Architect who can define, lead, and align our technology strategy across the entire healthcare platform ecosystem. In this role, you will

  • Set the architectural direction for our platform products
  • Oversee alignment across different products
  • Ensure long-term scalability, interoperability, and maintainability
  • Support international expansion into the wider European healthcare market

You will engage directly with

  • Customers to explore new clinical and operational workflows, and digital transformation needs
  • Partners to co-develop, integrate, and ensure compatibility within a modular platform ecosystem
  • Product Management and Product Owners to align architectural vision with product strategies and roadmaps

As an Enterprise Architect, you will

  • Define and evolve the enterprise-wide architecture for our healthcare platform products
  • Align architecture across product teams, domains, and business stakeholders
  • Drive adherence to healthcare standards such as openEHR, FHIR, and HL7
  • Lead strategic architectural initiatives such as modularization, capability-based planning, and platform evolution
  • Govern architecture principles and ensure compliance across all layers (business, application, data, and infrastructure)
  • Act as a key advisor to business and product leadership regarding technology roadmaps and transformation programs
  • Guide solution and software architects and foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
  • Contribute to technology partner strategies, vendor evaluations, and interoperability initiatives

We are looking for someone with:

  • Broad experience in enterprise architecture across complex product ecosystems
  • Deep understanding of architecture principles / frameworks
  • Proven ability to align business and technology strategies
  • Familiarity with open digital health platforms and healthcare-specific standards (openEHR, FHIR)
  • Experience designing scalable and modular architecture in cloud-native and containerized environments
  • Leadership experience in driving change and enterprise-wide architecture governance
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including international and partner collaboration

As a person you are:

  • Strategic in your thinking and system-minded
  • Collaborative and able to work across different teams, organizations and cultures
  • Committed to excellence and long-term impact
  • Curious, open-minded, and adaptable

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tietoevry has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Kari-Antti Kuosa ( )

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tietoevry declines calls from recruitment companies.

About Tietoevry

Tietoevry creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, wework with our customers to develop digitalfutureswhere businesses, societies, and humanitythrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public-sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tietoevry’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

#LI-Hybrid

Divers ity, equity and inclusion

At Tietoevry, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders, and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
